student_profiles.school_name: Government Girls Higher Secondary School, Madurai

intake_sessions.situation_text: My daughter is in Class 11 at a government school in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, and our household income is very low.
My son is in Class 12 at an aided school in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, and our income is low.
I am in Class 11 at a government girls school in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, and my family income is very low.
I am in Class 12 at an aided higher secondary school in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. We are a low-income family.

schemes.name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
schemes.short_description: Monthly support for girls studying in Class 11 and 12 in government and government-aided schools.
schemes.beneficiary_group: Girls in government and aided schools, Class 11-12
schemes.estimated_benefit: Rs 1,000 per month while studying, as published by the state
application_steps: Get the school bonafide certificate from your headmaster.
Get a family income certificate from the revenue office.
Open the official Tamil Nadu portal and create a student account.
Fill in the form and keep your papers ready for checking by the school.
Track the status on the same portal.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: If your daughter is a girl in Class 11 or 12 at a government or aided school, and your household income is within the published limit, she may qualify. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: Household income above the published limit
School type is not government or government-aided
Papers do not show the same student name

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.short_description: Tuition and living support for Scheduled Caste students in Class 11 and 12.
schemes.beneficiary_group: Scheduled Caste students in government and aided schools, Class 11-12
schemes.estimated_benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance at published state rates

required_conditions: community certificate issued by the revenue office

application_steps: Get the community certificate from the revenue office.
Ask your school to confirm your class and enrolment.
Register on the national scholarship portal.
Fill the application and submit it before the deadline.
Check the status on the portal after submitting.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students from Scheduled Caste families in Class 11 or 12 at government or aided schools may qualify if household income is within the published limit. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: Community certificate missing or expired
Household income above the published limit
Application submitted after the deadline

application_steps: Get the community certificate from the revenue office.

Fill the application and submit it before the deadline.

schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students from Backward Class or Most Backward Class families in Class 11 or 12 at government or aided schools may qualify if household income is within the published limit. The relevant authority makes the final decision.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship for OBC Students
schemes.short_description: Yearly scholarship for Other Backward Class students in Class 11 and 12.
schemes.estimated_benefit: Fixed yearly scholarship amount for Class 11-12 as published

required_conditions: community certificate issued by the revenue office

application_steps: Get the community certificate from the revenue office.
Collect your previous year marksheet from school.
Register on the national scholarship portal.
Fill the application and submit it before the deadline.
Track the status on the portal.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students from Other Backward Class families in Class 11 or 12 at government or aided schools may qualify if household income is within the published limit. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: Household income above the published limit

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
schemes.short_description: Merit-based yearly support for students who were selected in an earlier merit test and continue in Class 11 and 12.
schemes.estimated_benefit: Yearly scholarship amount as published for Class 11-12

required_conditions: selected in the Class 8 merit test under the scheme

application_steps: Find your scheme selection letter from school.
Get a family income certificate from the revenue office.
Ask your school to confirm your enrolment.
Submit the renewal form on the official portal.
Check the status on the portal.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students who were selected through the merit test in earlier classes and continue in Class 11 or 12 at government or aided schools may qualify. The relevant authority confirms the selection.
common_rejection_risks: No record of merit test selection
Household income above the published limit
Renewal form not submitted on time

schemes.name: Private School Higher Secondary Support Grant
schemes.short_description: One-time grant for low-income students in Class 11 and 12 at private schools.
schemes.beneficiary_group: Low-income students in private schools, Class 11-12
schemes.estimated_benefit: One-time grant of Rs 5,000 as published
application_steps: Get the school fee receipt from your school office.
Get a family income certificate from the revenue office.
Open the official portal and create an account.
Fill in the form and submit it before the deadline.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students in Class 11 or 12 at private schools whose household income is within the published limit may qualify. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: School is government or government-aided, not private
Household income above the published limit
Deadline already passed

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
schemes.short_description: Scholarship for students who have passed Class 12 and join a college course.
schemes.beneficiary_group: Students who passed Class 12 and join college
schemes.estimated_benefit: Yearly scholarship amount for college study as published

required_conditions: Class 12 board marks above the published minimum

application_steps: Collect your Class 12 marksheet after results.
Get a family income certificate from the revenue office.
Register on the national scholarship portal.
Fill the application and submit it before the deadline.
Check the status on the portal.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students who have finished Class 12 with the published minimum marks and join a college may qualify. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: Class 12 marks below the published minimum
Not yet in Class 12 or results not published
Household income above the published limit

schemes.name: Free Bus Pass for Government School Students
schemes.short_description: Free bus travel between home and school for students of government schools.
schemes.estimated_benefit: Free bus travel between home and school on government buses
application_steps: Ask your school for the bonafide certificate.
Get the school identity card from your school office.
Visit the bus pass counter with both papers.
Collect the pass after verification.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Students in Class 11 or 12 at government schools in Tamil Nadu may get a free bus pass. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: School is not a government school
School identity card not issued
Living outside the published route area

application_steps: Collect your Class 12 marksheet.
Ask your school to confirm your ranking.
Submit the merit award form on the official portal.
Check the result list published by the department.
schemes.plain_language_explanation: Top-ranked Class 12 students of government schools may receive a one-time merit award. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
common_rejection_risks: Board result not in the top group
Application submitted after the deadline
School is not a government school
